notes.title: Final Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone it's Sly Hopkins Studios just wanted to post a final update for Elf Kicker, I just added a 10 level pack of DLC that I had made a while ago and meant to release sooner, nonetheless this will most likely be the final update for Elf Kicker. I made this game as my first game with only 2 months of learning game dev, and while I knew it wasn't going to be the most hyper-realistic game or the most-well designed, I am fairly proud of it and hope I can look back on it as I continue my game dev journey. My next plans for game dev are to continue making games and working in the industry, you can find updates on my YouTube channel. Also I will be giving away a steam key or two in a future video.

Thank you to everyone who tried the game or plays it in the future, I really appreciate it. - Sly

** DLC level pack is around 5-10 minutes and is slightly increased difficulty

notes.title: Elf Kicker Update 1.2: Speed-running, DLC, fixes.
notes.content:
Update 1.2 introduces speed-running capabilities by introducing a timer in the corner of the game screen and an end game timer score.

Graphical changes: small update to menu graphic (fixed rock standing out)
small update to level 29: fixed elf head loading behind elf body

Other changes. Added link to Patreon in extras menu.

DLC levels pack is finished and waiting for testing to release, hoping to release in Early March, while it will be available in the store for pre-purchase now. 

Find more updates in an upcoming devlog on Youtube (Sly Hopkins)

notes.title: 1.1- Small Menu Changes
notes.content:
Patch 1.1 updates- 
Added level selection option for upcoming DLC. You can now select levels 1-30 or a DLC levels pack.
Added small graphical update in extras menu to make links and text bigger on screen.
Added way to support in extras menu and on end of game menu.
Added correct level name for one level which was displaying wrong level number during preview.

Thanks for playing Elf Kicker, if you want to see an update or have any bugs to report feel free to reach out- Sly Hopkins
